sections.text: New Zealand defeated Scotland 43-21 at Murrayfield after a close first half that saw Ewan Ashman score a hat-trick for Scotland. The All Blacks took control in the second half, securing a systematic dismantling finished off by Beauden Barrett's second try.

sections.heading: Why it matters

gist: Lando Norris took pole for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix in wet conditions.
Qualifying at Interlagos was delayed for nearly an hour and a half due to heavy rain.
Engine-related grid penalties significantly reshaped the starting grid for the race.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Lando Norris secured pole position for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix during a rain-delayed qualifying session at Interlagos. Heavy rain delayed the start by an hour and a half. Wet conditions allowed drivers in usually uncompetitive cars to perform well, while several drivers incurred grid penalties for engine parts.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The wet weather levelled the playing field, allowing drivers like Fernando Alonso, Oliver Bearman, Nico Hulkenberg and Liam Lawson to achieve some of their best qualifying results of the year. Grid penalties for drivers including George Russell, Charles Leclerc, Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton also changed the final starting lineup.

gist: Manchester United drew four-all with Aston Villa after scoring a stoppage-time equaliser.
Manager Michael Carrick remains in his position despite United dropping into the relegation zone.
Fans protested against club owners and ticket prices amid poor league form.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Manchester United drew four-all against Aston Villa in an eight-goal thriller at Old Trafford. United fought back twice from two goals down, securing a point with a ninety-sixth-minute equaliser from Patrick Dorgu. The result left United in eighteenth place in the relegation zone during the international break.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: United are in their lowest league position for forty years after playing at least ten matches, having failed to win a league game since August. The poor form has intensified pressure on manager Michael Carrick and sparked unprecedented fan protests against ticket prices and club ownership.
